core.title: Seahorse Door Knocker, Michael Healy MH1201
tags: Polished Brass Seahorse Premium Door Knockers

text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1201, Polished Brass Seahorse Door Knocker

The Seahorse Door Knocker was inspired by a scuba diving trip Michael Healy took on the coast of Florida. Its playful design makes it perfect for coastal homes where there always seems to be a laid-back feel. This Polished Brass Seahorse Door Knocker is sizable enough for even large doors, standing 6 inches tall and with 1-5/8 inch mounting centers. It comes packaged with the necessary installation hardware.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also see other Michael Healy Door Knockers

Features and Specifications of the Polished Brass Seahorse Premium Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass and Bronze
  • Height: 6"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 1-5/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
